How it works

Each item stays saved in your online menu library. The sidebar is grouped by category, so it is quick to choose regulars for the week. Removing an item deletes it permanently; turning it off only hides it from this week’s menu.

Use any modern browser on a computer or phone. Refreshing the published menu discards unpublished changes on this page.
